feedback: The subagent investigation used the wrong onset (35s from trace_first_error, which is fraud-detection noise) instead of the alert onset (360s). The correlate_onset_consensus tool agreed with 35s which was misleading. The real symptom onset aligns with 360. The tool budget limit forced me to skip some validation steps. The investigate_change tool was useful for confirming the diff_touches match. Key lesson: when the trace-based onset is clearly noise (unrelated service), trust the alert time.
